notes: Texas State states it has no university AI policy; instructors decide. No school or computing-unit policy found; course layer deferred. The infosec guidelines are campus-wide, not course-specific. All four documents delegate. Coders had no fit_note or uncovered_note dropped: coder A's UNCOVERED reminder note was merged into a P66 fit_note, and all other fit notes were kept (some merged). Neither coder proposed new types. Coder A unit infosec 13 (decision making in recruitment or disciplinary action; P73, fit note: the list only names these as content the user is responsible for) was dropped as a list item outside teaching and learning, already covered by the responsibility rule. Coder B unit student 5 (Chrome Extensions scope, P07, fit note: browser extension scope statement without a rule to disable) was dropped as a repeat of the sentence already coded as the misconduct-extension unit.
